string.name: emailConfirm_click
string.comment:
emailConfirm_click
Part of the confirmation email upon registering for a LiXiangQi account.
The unique reset link is presented just after this string.

resources.string: Chofoza isixhumanisi ukuze unike amandla i-akhawunti yakho LiXiangQi:
Setha kabusha iphasiwedi yakho ye- lixiangqi.com, %s
Sithole isicelo sokusetha kabusha iphasiwedi ye-akhawunti yakho.
Uma wenze lesi sicelo, chofoza kusixhumanisi esingezansi. Uma kungenjalo, ungayinaka le imeyili.
Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uyakwazi ukufinyelela le imeyili, sicela uchofoze isixhumanisi esingezansi:
Le yi-imeyili yesevisi ehlobene nokusebenzisa kwakho %s.
I-akhawunti yakho ye-LiXiangQi isilungile. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ufunda imithetho noma ubuyela emdlalweni, siyajabula ukukubona lapha.
Qala umdlalo ekhasini lokuqala. Ukuze uqale ngokukhululeka, zama ukudlala nekhompyutha.
Ziqeqeshe ukubona izinsongo nokuthola iminyakazo yokunqoba. Ungasheshi: bheka ukuhlaselwa kwenkosi, ukuthathwa kwezicucu nokuthi imbangi ingaphendula kanjani.
Faka isingeniso esifushane kuphrofayela yakho ukuze abanye abadlali bakwazi.
Jabulela umdlalo wakho olandelayo. Sizobonana ebhodini!
